headword: {原材料名|げんざいりょうめい}
gloss: list of ingredients (on a food label)

definitions.gloss: list of ingredients (on a food label)
definitions.explanation: The "ingredients" heading on a packaged-food label, listing what the product is made from in order of quantity. {原材料|げんざいりょう} (raw materials, ingredients) + {名|めい} (names).

examples.japanese: {原材料名|げんざいりょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{原材料名|げんざいりょうめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I have allergies, so I read the ingredients carefully.

examples.japanese: {原材料名|げんざいりょうめい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: Ingredients are listed in order from the largest quantity used.

notes:
⟦{原材料|げんざいりょう}→原材料：18966_genzairyou⟧ (raw materials, ingredients) + {名|めい} (name). The standard label heading under which ingredients are listed by descending weight.
